metadata.title: Stable Capillary Minimal Hypersurfaces in $\R^4_+$
metadata.abstract: We prove that a complete, two-sided, stable capillary minimal hypersurface in $\R^4_+$ is flat provided its contact angle $\theta$ satisfies $|\cot\theta|<\kappa_*$, where $\kappa_*=4\Gamma(3/4)^2/\Gamma(1/4)^2\approx 0.45$.
